verdicts.reason: A breaks the hierarchy and reading order. The RSVP CTA is shrunk to a pill and lumped in with the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS chips in the top-left corner, overlapping the decorative circle. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped below the URL. The date, tagline, time and URL sit jammed together with no spacing and mixed alignment (left and centred), and there is a big empty band under the can. B keeps the original's order and hierarchy but is basically a narrowed copy. The pill text is tiny, the text block is ragged-left beside a can that floats off to the right, and there is a large dead gap above the CTA. Both still show the missing-asset placeholder box.
